### ✨ New Features

patches.name: Disable Startup Permissions
patches.description: Suppresses indiscriminate startup requests for camera and storage permissions, and configures manifest for direct system camera capture.

patches.name: Hide Gift Button
patches.description: Hides the gift / donation button in the top action bar of the main menu.

patches.name: Remove All Ads
patches.description: Disables all AdMob preloading, bypasses interstitial ads, and auto-removes the watermark on receipt screens without user interaction.

patches.name: Bypass Review Dialog
patches.description: Bypasses the in-app review confirmation dialog when pressing Back on the Home screen, allowing immediate exit.

patches.name: Hide Premium Button
patches.description: Hides the Premium upgrade button from both the top action bar on the Home screen and the Settings menu.

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Removes all banner and interstitial ads by unlocking ad-free premium status and disabling AdMob loaders.

patches.name: Disable Licensing
patches.description: Bypasses PairIP license verification to prevent 'Something went wrong' errors on emulators and devices without Google Play.

patches.name: Lifetime Premium
patches.description: Unlocks lifetime premium: removes watermark forever, disables ads, unlocks all templates.
